breakdown.description: The prompt sets the support slopes to zero under symmetric loading, but a simply supported beam under uniform load still rotates at the supports.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly omits the erroneous instruction to set end slopes to zero. It does not repeat the incorrect claim that support slopes are zero under symmetric loading. Instead, it simply asks to compute the slope at x = 0, which aligns with the ground truth prompt that also removes this incorrect boundary condition.
